control.label: FLY BRAIN (connectome) decides when to escape; code flies the airplane
control.neurons_decide: escape request: Giant Fibre (DNp01) response to synthetic looming and path cues; training retains looming-only input
control.code_decides: synthetic visual encoding, turn direction (from obstacle geometry), holding altitude, speed and heading, and flying the avoidance turn (conventional FlightController)
control.autopilot: never: the fly does not use the airplane autopilot/autothrottle; AutopilotGuard forces it off and stops the run if it cannot
